title: MarshalEnvelope
description: The one response envelope every marshal command emits (AD-14, AD-39): {schema_version, command, status, verdict, data, data_version, findings, assumptions}. status is a pure function of verdict (status_for) and is never set independently. additionalProperties is false at both the envelope and finding level -- an unrecognized/typo'd key is a schema violation; a genuinely new field is an envelope-schema change (AD-14), not a silent addition. 'data' stays open (type: object with no declared properties) since its shape is per-command and opaque to this envelope.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version; bumps only on a breaking change to the envelope KEYS. Additive fields do not bump it.

command.description: The marshal command that produced this envelope.

verdict.description: The closed 6-member lattice, strongest first: error > gate-failed > scope-violation > unevaluable > warn > clean (AD-7, AD-31).

data.description: Command-specific payload, opaque to this envelope.

data_version.description: The data payload's own version, from a registry, bumped independently of schema_version (AD-39).

code.description: Stable machine code from the central registry (AD-15, core/findings.py).

severity.description: Presentational only; the lattice member comes from verdict.classify(code) (AD-31).
